prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished transparent production RTS animation atlas, NOT concept art. Input reference is ONLY character identity; entirely remove card border, background and scene. Preserve SAME armor, anatomy, colors, equipment and silhouette. Create ACTUAL DIFFERENT DRAWN BODY/WEAPON ANIMATION POSES, no static cutout transformations.
Strict 24 COLUMNS by 8 ROWS of equal rectangular cells on a 2:1 landscape canvas, NO margins, NO lines, NO text. Precisely192 full-body sprites on transparent alpha background, each sprite fits within own cell and baseline is steady. Isometric RTS overhead camera, 35degrees downward. CRITICAL ROW FACINGS: row1 NORTH, BACK VIEW, show back of head/backpack NOT face, pointed AWAY toward top of screen; row2 NORTHEAST REAR-RIGHT view, show back+right shoulder; row3 EAST side view, points right; row4 SOUTHEAST front-right view; row5 SOUTH FRONT VIEW, face toward bottom of screen; row6 SOUTHWEST front-left view; row7 WEST SIDE VIEW points left; row8 NORTHWEST REAR-LEFT view, show back+left shoulder. ROTATE THE CHARACTER IN3D among rows, not rotate canvas. Every frame within a row faces that row's exact compass direction. Four rear-view rows must visibly show back surfaces.
In EVERY ROW columns1-4 = complete subtle idle breathing/readiness sequence; columns5-10 =6 genuinely articulated continuous gait/movement frames with distinct left-contact, passing, lift, right-contact, passing, lift, no excessive bobbing; columns11-15 =5 distinct attack preparation, strike/fire contact, recoil/swing followthrough and recovery frames; columns16-17 =2 genuine hit recoil poses; columns18-22 =5 death sequence standing failure, buckle, fall, collapsed body, fading debris appropriate material; columns23-24 =2 special ability channel/activation poses unique to subject. Entire character remains a consistent size and stable pivot. Animate legs/arms/claws or wingbeats/treads correctly. Death may collapse but stays within cell. No ground tiles or dramatic shadows, no duplicate poses, no extra characters. Fine painted textured sci-fi sprites, strong contrast, readable atsmall RTSsize. True transparency, soft edge alpha; no background color.
Subject specifics: Void Lancer: tall slender gold white angular floating/legged siege construct with narrow huge forward lance glowing violet. Real articulated lowerlimbs moving stride, energy core pulsing; attack lance forward/charged violet beam/recoil; death gold fragments and violet energy collapse; ability charged concentratedvoidspear.

combat.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: precise production-ready transparent 2D RTS sprite atlas, combat animation for voidLancer. Input image is a DESIGN IDENTITY reference only. Preserve recognizable full unit silhouette, materials, geometry, asymmetric equipment and palette. Generate genuinely new painted articulated animation frames. Remove all reference background/card borders. No scene.
STRICT EXACT GRID: 7 COLUMNS x 8 ROWS, 56 independent sprites total. Equal square cells each160x160, whole canvas ideally1120x1280. No labels, no text, no grid lines, no outer margins.
CRITICAL GUTTERS: each COMPLETE unit (all nose/lance/wing tips/legs/effects) fits inside 75% of cell width and 80% of cell height. Each cell MUST have at least 12% width CLEAR TRANSPARENT gutter on left and right and 10% height gutter above and below. Never overlap adjacent cells. No intercell haze. Fit the entire long lance/pointed prow INSIDE each cell, even side-view frames. Smaller complete unit is better than clipped weapon. Stable center anchor, identical scale across all frames, no whole-frame translation/scaling.
Detailed painted non-pixel science fiction, overhead three-quarter fixed 35 degree downward camera, high-contrast readable miniature art. True alpha transparent background, no checkerboard.
Row1=NORTH, backside/rear visible, pointed nose/lance UP toward top of screen. Row2=NORTHEAST rear-right view, nose/lance UP-RIGHT. Row3=EAST right side profile, nose/lance points exactly RIGHT. Row4=SOUTHEAST front-right view, nose/lance DOWN-RIGHT. Row5=SOUTH front view, nose/lance points exactly DOWN toward bottom/viewer. Row6=SOUTHWEST front-left view, nose/lance DOWN-LEFT. Row7=WEST left side profile, nose/lance exactly LEFT. Row8=NORTHWEST rear-left view, nose/lance UP-LEFT. These are actual 3D object orientations under one fixed overhead/three-quarter camera, not simply repeating the source front view. Back views must show rear plating/engines and weapons pointing away, different from front.
Within EACH row columns1-5 are FIVE ATTACK poses: prepare weapon, fire at column2, physical recoil, energy follow-through, recover. Columns6-7 are TWO HIT reaction poses: shudder/recoil with small shield sparks then recovering. Weapon faces exact row direction. Keep ALL lance/wing parts and compact firing energy effects fully inside own cell. No extended laser crossing neighboring cells.
Void Lancer: an ivory-white and gold angular legged siege construct with narrow armored tall chassis, multiple slender splayed articulated legs and a HUGE forward-pointing violet crystal lance projecting from its central hull. Preserve the whole long lance, never cut it at any cell border. Idle bright purple core pulses while small chassis pieces articulate. Move must show six actual distinct alternating articulated leg-stride poses with hip, joint and foot changes. Attack lance charges purple, braces and fires violet focused beam, crystal cannon physically recoils, then energy dims and resets. Hit chassis recoils with shield sparks. Death upper structure buckles, lance cracks, legs fold, gold/white fragmented body collapses, scattered crystal rubble. Special ability channels a concentrated violet void spear from the full lance.
Every one of 56 sprites required. Preserve exactly 7 columns, all8rows, with clear gutters. No extra frames, no omissions, no cropped limbs, no background rectangles. This sheet is directly sliced on its EXACT evenly spaced grid.
